items.title: Fix Clickability of Text Labels in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where text labels in the accessibility tree were unclickable due to incorrect hit-testing logic. The fix modifies the hit-test criteria to allow clicks on text nodes by considering both ancestor and descendant relationships. A new test has been added to ensure the functionality works as expected, resulting in all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Enhance Grant Rejection Clarity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of grant rejections by introducing named error codes for each of the 11 distinct rejection scenarios. The response now includes structured details, allowing for better logging and debugging. This change addresses issues where different rejection reasons were indistinguishable, enhancing overall system transparency.

items.title: Enhance Suno Task Retrieval with Batch Action in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the Suno CLI to explicitly use the `retrieve_batch` action for batch task requests. The change ensures that the CLI sends the correct action along with the task IDs, improving the accuracy of batch task retrieval. Additionally, regression tests have been added to verify the complete request payload.

items.title: AI-Driven Domain Blocking Enhancements in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces an AI-based system for dynamically blocking disposable email domains, moving away from a static hardcoded list. A new CronJob aggregates registration data daily, allowing for real-time updates to the blocklist without code changes. Additionally, the exemption criteria for accounts have been refined to ensure genuine customers are not affected while effectively targeting abuse.

items.title: Update OpenAI Image Size Default to Auto in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the OpenAI specifications by changing the default image size for the `openai_generate_image` function from `1024x1024` to `auto`, aligning it with the documentation. The `openai_edit_image` function already used `auto`, ensuring consistency across tools. Additionally, tests have been added to verify this behavior, enhancing the reliability of image generation.

items.title: Updated Voice Cloning Documentation for Clarity in Backend 🎤
items.summary: This update replaces broken audio examples in the voice cloning documentation with verified samples from our CDN, ensuring users have reliable resources. Key changes include a clarified audio duration cap, documentation of system-generated names, and a note on retrying failed requests. These improvements aim to enhance user experience and reduce errors during voice cloning.

items.title: Fix checksum handling for EVM call arguments in x402 🔧
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where X402 crypto top-ups were failing due to improper checksum handling of EVM call arguments. The fix ensures that both contract addresses and call arguments are checksummed, preventing local encoding errors that previously surfaced as misleading simulation failures. This change is expected to restore functionality for users experiencing transaction issues.

items.title: Enhance WeChat Setup Instructions in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the WeChat channel setup instructions by adding crucial prerequisites and safety defaults. Key changes include specifying the need to install and log in to the CLI tools, clarifying the implications of the default settings, and addressing the process for running background services. These enhancements aim to prevent user confusion and ensure a smoother setup experience.

items.title: fix support page to show tenant contacts instead of ours in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the support page to ensure that tenant users see their own contact information instead of our Discord invite and other channels. The changes include implementing `rebrandContent()` for the page body and adjusting the SEO URL to reflect the tenant's site. This prevents confusion for users landing on the support page and improves the overall user experience.

items.title: Fix sorting issue for pinned services in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where unpinned services were incorrectly sorted ahead of pinned ones due to a default value of 0. The fix introduces a new constant, UNPINNED_SORT_ORDER, ensuring that unconfigured rows sort after all pinned services. Two regression tests have been added to verify this behavior, enhancing the reliability of the sorting mechanism.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI Image Edits with Multiple Inputs in Clis 🎨
items.summary: This update allows the CLI to support multiple image URLs for the OpenAI image edit command, enhancing flexibility for users. The `--image-url` option is now repeatable, accommodating up to 16 URLs while maintaining support for single URL inputs. Additionally, validation has been added to reject requests exceeding the limit, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Update OpenAI Image Edit Defaults in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the OpenAI image-edit tool to set the default image size to 'auto' instead of '1024x1024', aligning with the latest OpenAPI specifications. Additionally, a focused regression test has been added to ensure the default request payload correctly includes 'size: "auto"'. These changes enhance the functionality and usability of the image-edit feature.

items.title: Update Documentation for Image Size Behavior in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update clarifies the behavior of the `size: auto` parameter in the image generation and editing APIs. Key changes include accurate descriptions in the documentation, reflecting how the model determines image dimensions based on input prompts. Additionally, the default size has been updated to 'auto' to preserve aspect ratios, enhancing user experience.

items.title: Automate Free Credit Cutoff Process in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new CronJob to automate the disabling of restricted applications, which was previously a manual process. The change addresses a significant gap where free credits were being consumed without proper oversight, resulting in a loss of 2790 credits. The implementation includes necessary safeguards and tests to ensure reliability and prevent future issues.

items.title: Enhanced Domain Blocking and Logging in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update expands the blocked email domain list from 34 to 80, effectively preventing 714 suspicious registrations that previously slipped through. Additionally, logging has been improved for three interception points, allowing for better monitoring and alerting of blocked signups. These changes aim to enhance the security and efficiency of the registration process.

items.title: Explicitly Send Size=Auto for OpenAI Image in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the size parameter is explicitly sent as 'auto' instead of being omitted, aligning with the OpenAPI documentation. Key changes include the addition of a new constant for 'auto' size, modifications to the ResolutionSelector component, and the introduction of a dedicated i18n key for the size option. The changes maintain existing behavior while improving clarity and consistency in the API.

items.title: Fix session landing issue on consumer homepage in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue where sessions default to the consumer homepage when `initial_url` is not declared, leading to navigation inefficiencies and potential data loss during publishing. The `SKILL.md` file has been modified to include an explicit `initial_url`, ensuring users land on the correct creator page. Additionally, tests have been updated to validate this change, confirming that all assertions pass successfully.

items.title: Fix incorrect attribution in origin drift guard in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the comments in the origin drift guard, clarifying that the previous incident was due to a session renewal rather than a page redirect. The logic remains unchanged, ensuring that only our own navigation modifies the session's origin. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the functionality.

items.title: Fix session renewal failure leading to homepage redirects in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where session renewals were failing due to mismatched deadlines, causing users to be redirected to the homepage unexpectedly. Key changes include modifying the session manager to retry renewals and adjusting how deadlines are read from session records. A new test has been added to ensure that renewals can survive deadline discrepancies, improving overall session handling.

items.title: Enhance Image Size Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the image request handling to forward the size parameter as 'auto' instead of stripping it. Both the bananarouter and openaihk workers now allow the upstream to utilize the 'auto' size, improving the output quality based on the prompt. Comprehensive tests confirm that the changes maintain existing functionality while enhancing flexibility.

items.title: Automate Cleanup of Expired Browser Transfers in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update integrates the `cleanup_browser_transfers` command into the daily cleanup CronJob, ensuring that expired browser transfer receipts are now properly removed. Previously, these receipts accumulated without being addressed, leading to potential clutter in the system. The implementation has been tested and confirmed to clear all expired entries effectively.

items.title: Enhance Error Reporting for Relay Responses in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves error handling in the browser-relay by ensuring that detailed error messages are captured and reported instead of just the status codes. Key changes include modifications to the `post()` method to throw descriptive errors when relay requests fail. The implementation has been validated with new test cases, demonstrating a significant increase in passing tests.

items.title: Fix stale origin issue during page navigation in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where commands continued to execute on an outdated document after a page self-redirected. Key changes include real-time URL checks before command execution and adjustments to handle cases where the URL cannot be retrieved. The fix ensures that commands are only executed on authorized documents, improving session reliability.

items.title: Empower Tenant Homepages with Custom Banners in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update allows tenant homepages to display their own banners instead of default ones. Key changes include dynamic hero backgrounds sourced from tenant-configured banners and the removal of product promotion slides for white-label storefronts. The implementation ensures that banner outages do not disrupt homepage visibility and enhances security for external links.

items.title: Enhance Responses Streaming Lifecycle in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update fixes the responses streaming lifecycle for `gpt-5*` models routed through `github-proxy`, addressing issues that rendered them unusable from Codex CLI and OpenAI SDKs. Key changes include the addition of multiple event types to ensure proper delta attribution and item tracking, which resolves silent failures in streaming. Comprehensive tests have been added, with all 87 tests passing successfully.

items.title: Expose Public Banner Feed for Tenant Homepages in Backend 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a public banner feed that allows tenant homepages to render site banners. The new `PublicSiteBannerListView` enables anonymous access while ensuring that tenant-specific data remains secure. Additionally, five new tests have been added to verify the functionality, with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Enhance Tenant Footer Privacy in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update prevents the display of our legal identity in tenant footers, addressing compliance issues related to ICP filings. Key changes include using the tenant's own ICP and ensuring that our branding is only shown on our own sites. The footer now dynamically adjusts based on the tenant's domain, enhancing privacy and compliance.

items.title: Reordered Channels for Nano-Banana in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: The channel order for nano-banana has been updated to prioritize cqtai over mountsea. This change affects both the `/nano-banana` and `/nano-banana/tasks` routes, ensuring consistency across the board. All policies remain unchanged, and the configuration has been validated successfully.

items.title: Remove external link icons from chat menu in Nexior 🚫
items.summary: This update removes the external link icons from the 'Skills' and 'Connections' dropdown items in the chat input menu, as both now navigate to internal pages. The change eliminates potential user confusion regarding navigation. Additionally, unused imports and styles related to external links have been cleaned up.

items.title: Fix WeChat Embedded Login White Screen in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical issue where the WeChat embedded login displayed a white screen on mobile devices. The solution involves redirecting the authorization process to the host application, allowing the WeChat client to handle the native consent interface correctly. Additionally, the URL construction for authorization has been streamlined for consistency across different paths.

items.title: Fix CI Hang with Jest in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the CI process was hanging due to a persistent MongoDB connection in the `persister` module. By adding `forceExit: true` to the Jest configuration, the tests will now exit cleanly after completion. Additional changes include mocking new exports and replacing the `uuid` dependency with `crypto.randomUUID` for cleaner code.

items.title: Eliminate Brand Leakage for Tenants in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical branding issues by preventing the exposure of our logo, wordmark, and PWA identity to tenant sites. Key changes include modifying the Logo component to ensure tenants display their own branding, updating the manifest.json to reflect tenant-specific information, and implementing checks to remove any hardcoded references. These improvements enhance tenant customization and maintain brand integrity across the platform.

items.title: Fix call_id type to support uploads and screenshots in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update changes the `call_id` field from a UUID to a string to align with the actual format used by the aichat2 model. This fix resolves the 400 errors encountered during uploads and screenshots, ensuring that the system correctly processes the call IDs. Additionally, the migration is safe and does not disrupt existing data integrity.

items.title: Fix WeChat Login White Screen Issue in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the WeChat embedded browser would display a white screen during the login process. By implementing a postMessage mechanism, the authorization URL is now correctly handled, allowing the host to navigate the top window and display the native authorization interface. This change enhances user experience and ensures proper functionality within the WeChat environment.

items.title: Refine Error Handling and Improve Diagnostics in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the redundant resolve call that was misrepresenting diagnostics as fixes. Key changes include enhancements to error reporting and the retention of diagnostic capabilities, ensuring accurate status codes are sent to the cloud. The version has been updated to 0.7.31, with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Fix aspect ratio detection for base64 inputs in Platform Service 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where images without an aspect ratio were defaulting to a 1:1 ratio, causing distortion. The fix involves reordering the processing of base64 images to ensure they are converted to CDN URLs before aspect ratio detection. Additionally, the default resolution is now set to 1K when omitted, aligning behavior across different channels.

items.title: Eliminate Brand Flash on White-Label Sites in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue of brand flashing on white-label sites like www.juheai.ai during initial load. By implementing an inline script, the title and other brand-related metadata are now dynamically adjusted to reflect the tenant's domain, ensuring a seamless user experience. The changes enhance privacy for users while maintaining brand integrity for official domains.

items.title: New Forced Language Option for Site Settings in Nexior 🌐
items.summary: This update introduces a 'Forced Language' option in the site settings, allowing administrators to set a fixed interface language for all users. If not set, the system will continue to detect the language automatically. The implementation ensures that once a forced language is set, users cannot switch languages, enhancing consistency across the site.

items.title: Add Forced Locale for Site Interface Language in Backend 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a new `forced_locale` field to the Site model, allowing site administrators to set a fixed interface language. This change prevents the automatic detection of language by browsers, ensuring a consistent user experience. Additionally, validation methods have been implemented to ensure that the forced language is supported and to maintain cross-field consistency.

items.title: Fix content rejection mapping to avoid failover retries in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue where error code 451 was incorrectly mapped to a 500 ApiError, causing unnecessary failover retries. Now, explicit content refusals will be mapped to a 403 ForbiddenError, reducing alert noise and improving system efficiency. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure the correct handling of these scenarios.

items.title: Show Tenant's Selling Price for Packages in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the tenant's selling price is displayed correctly when browsing packages, aligning it with the checkout price. Key changes include modifications to the `ServiceDetailSerializer` and `ApplicationSerializer` to utilize the same pricing logic, eliminating discrepancies. The implementation has been verified with additional tests to ensure accuracy and consistency across the platform.

items.title: Fix WeChat QR Code Login to Stay in Iframe in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the WeChat QR code login would redirect the entire page when successful, instead of remaining within the embedded iframe. Key changes include setting the `self_redirect` parameter to 'true' and removing the `allow-top-navigation` permission from the iframe sandbox. These adjustments enhance user experience by preventing unwanted page navigation and ensuring a smoother login process.

items.title: Fix context loss in bridge sessions for Claude in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where bridge sessions were losing context when running with the 1M token model. Key changes include enhancements to the model directory to support the 1M context and adjustments to the resume functionality to ensure the correct model is used. Four new tests have been added to verify the changes and ensure stability.
